qs.q: Who was the dermatologist credited with first describing dermatomyositis in 1891?
qs.e: Dermatomyositis was first described by the dermatologist Unna in 1891. Bohan and Peter are associated with the classification criteria.

qs.q: Which cutaneous manifestation is specifically associated with dermatomyositis, presenting on the eyelids?
qs.e: Dermatomyositis is associated with a characteristic heliotrope rash on the eyelids. A malar butterfly rash is classically seen in systemic lupus erythematosus rather than dermatomyositis.

qs.q: A patient with dermatomyositis is evaluated for respiratory involvement. Aside from pulmonary fibrosis and bronchial carcinoma, what structural component is characteristically affected in the airways and chest wall?
qs.e: Dermatomyositis and polymyositis characteristically involve intercostal and diaphragmatic myopathy. Esophageal disease leading to aspiration pneumonia is a feature of systemic sclerosis.
